subject: GovCloud SOC 2 recert: evidence staging, retention window, and burst-seat pathway
messages:
From: AcmeGov Security <security@acmegov.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, AcmeGov Procurement <procurement@acmegov.com>
Cc: AcmeGov CloudOps <ops@acmegovcloud.gov>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert request — GovCloud evidence window and retention requirements

Rafael / Redwood team,

Following our Q3 procurement review, AcmeGov is starting the SOC 2 recert process for our GovCloud workloads with a target attestation date of mid-November. To scope the evidence handoff we need:

- A detailed manifest of what logs/audit trails you can provide for GovCloud (S3 object paths, retention durations, and access logs).
- Options for a 90-day burst-seat ramp for November (we'll likely need a temporary throughput increase during parallel testing).
- Confirmation that data in GovCloud uses customer-managed KMS or HSM and how key rotation is handled.

Can you provide an evidence staging plan (preferred dates for a bulk transfer, staging S3 bucket instructions, and a proposed retention matrix) and a contract amendment path for a short-term seat uplift plus the SOC 2 recert term change?

Attachments: evidence_request_template.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lina Ortega
Director, Security
Acme Government Services
security@acmegov.com

--
[Attachment stub: evidence_request_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: AcmeGov Security <security@acmegov.com>, AcmeGov Procurement <procurement@acmegov.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request — GovCloud evidence window and retention requirements

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a practical plan we can execute this week to hit an early-November recert window: 

1) Evidence manifest: attached is an initial manifest (evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx) with the per-service artifacts we can export from GovCloud: audit.log streams (30/90/365 day retention buckets), API access logs, key rotation audit, and snapshot exports of config drift.

2) Staging & transfer: we recommend a two-stage handoff — (A) a bulk S3 export to an AcmeGov-staging bucket (we'll provide presigned PUT instructions) over a secure transfer window (proposed Nov 1–3), then (B) a rolling verification pass where AcmeGov pulls sample items and we hand back hashes. See s3_transfer_instructions.txt attached.

3) Retention matrix & contract change: we can support a 365d retention carveout for GovCloud with a contract addendum. For the short-term 90-day burst seat (3x baseline throughput), we propose a timeboxed amendment: 90 days at a blended uplift rate. Kimberly (CC) will provide a pro-forma amendment and pricing.

4) KMS/HSM: GovCloud offering supports customer-managed KMS. We'll include HSM-backed key options for the added retention tier. Karthik, can your team confirm the key rotation artifact we will export for the audit (rotation dates, access logs)?

Next steps:
- I will upload the manifest and transfer instructions to the shared Drive link and email DocuSign for the proposed addendum once Kimberly confirms pricing.
- Proposed timeline: evidence upload Nov 1–3, verification Nov 4–7, sign amendment by Nov 10 to finalize attestation window.

Let me know any constraints from procurement or CloudOps.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Security & GTM
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx, s3_transfer_instructions.txt

--
[Attachment stub: evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment stub: s3_transfer_instructions.txt (txt)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, AcmeGov Security <security@acmegov.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request — GovCloud evidence window and retention requirements

Lina / team —

Thanks Rafael. From a commercial perspective we can accommodate the 90-day burst-seat uplift under a short addendum. Rough terms: 
- 90-day uplift at 2.5x base seat rate for throughput (blended pricing);
- 365-day retention carveout adds a fixed monthly fee to cover storage and longer-term access logs;
- We can issue a PO-ready DocuSign for the addendum; deal id ACME-GOV-2026-RW will be referenced on the amendment.

Vanessa: please prepare a pricing summary and a pro-forma amendment we can send to Procurement. Also confirm that Dedicated-capacity onramp is an option if AcmeGov prefers isolation during attest.

Kimberly Park
Head of Renewals & Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

--
[Attachment stub: retention_matrix_govcloud.pdf (pdf)]

From: AcmeGov Procurement <procurement@acmegov.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeGov Security <security@acmegov.com>, AcmeGov CloudOps <ops@acmegovcloud.gov>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request — GovCloud evidence window and retention requirements

Kimberly / Rafael —

Appreciate the quick plan. A few clarifying items from procurement and CloudOps: 
- We need the DocuSign with the final numbers by Friday (10/22) to meet internal sign-off cycles. Can you confirm you can turn the amendment by EOD 10/22?
- KMS: please confirm whether Redwood will accept AcmeGov-managed keys in an HSM (we require customer key custody for Gov workloads). If not, provide a clearly documented exception path.
- Dedicated vs burst: Dedicated will require a different procurement path. For speed, we prefer the timeboxed burst-seat addendum unless Redwood can commit to a dedicated pool start date within 30 days.

Also, CloudOps flagged a preference for SHA256+ manifest hashes rather than MD5 for verification.

Thanks —
Marcus Reed
Senior Contracts Manager
Acme Government Services
procurement@acmegov.com

--
[Attachment: none]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: AcmeGov Procurement <procurement@acmegov.com>, AcmeGov Security <security@acmegov.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request — GovCloud evidence window and retention requirements

Marcus / Lina —

All good — we can meet the DocuSign deadline Friday 10/22. Actions I am taking now: 
- Kimberly is assembling the amendment + pricing and I will review it this afternoon. Expect DocuSign link sent by Thursday AM latest so you have time for an internal review.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood GovCloud supports customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys; we will produce the key rotation artifact (rotation timestamps, principal IDs, and access logs) as part of the manifest. Karthik will attach the rotation export to the staging folder.
- Verification: we will generate SHA256 hashes for the manifest and include them in the evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx.
- Dedicated vs burst: if AcmeGov elects Dedicated we will map a start date but agree that for speed the 90-day burst addendum is the recommended path to keep attestation on pace.

Next steps (summary):
- Thu 10/22 AM: DocuSign sent with amendment (90-day burst & 365d retention carveout)
- Nov 1–3: evidence export window (S3 presigned PUTs)
- Nov 4–7: verification support and sampling
- Nov 10: target sign-off for SOC 2 submission

I'll post the DocuSign link and shared Drive folder once Kimberly gives the green light. Thanks for the quick coordination.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Security & GTM
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

--
[Attachment stub: none]
